fine_lines.title: so vs either (agreeing)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: للموافقة على جملة مثبتة نستخدم so مع قلب الترتيب: I like comics and so does he. للموافقة على جملة منفية نستخدم either في آخر الجملة: She can't whistle and I can't either.
fine_lines.explanation_en: To agree with a positive sentence, use so + verb + subject: I like comics and so does he. To agree with a negative sentence, use not ... either at the end: She can't whistle and I can't either.

examples.sentence: He's good at flying kites and so am I.
I don't like ball sports and he doesn't either.

fine_lines.title: so am I / so do I / so can I
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الفعل بعد so يطابق الفعل في الجملة الأولى: am/is/are → so am I. فعل عادي في المضارع → so do/does. can → so can.
fine_lines.explanation_en: The verb after so matches the first sentence: be → so am I; a normal present verb → so do/does; can → so can.

examples.sentence: He is good at kites and so am I.
He likes to read comics and so do I.
I can play the ukulele and so can he.

grammar.title: Agreeing with so, too, either and neither
grammar.explanation_ar: لربط جملتين متشابهتين دون تكرار الفعل: 1) جملة مثبتة: and so + فعل مساعد + فاعل (and so am I، and so can he، and so do I). لاحظ قلب الترتيب بعد so: I am → am I. 2) جملة منفية: and + فاعل + فعل مساعد منفي + either (and I can't either). الفعل المساعد يطابق الجملة الأولى: be → am/is/are، can → can، فعل عادي → do/does/did.
grammar.explanation_en: To join two similar ideas without repeating the verb: 1) Positive: and so + helping verb + subject (and so am I, and so can he, and so do I). Notice the order changes after so: I am → am I. 2) Negative: and + subject + negative helping verb + either (and I can't either). The helping verb matches the first sentence: be, can, or do/does/did.
examples: She can't whistle and I can't either.
I don't like ball sports and he doesn't either.
He's good at flying kites and so am I.
He likes to read comics and so do I.
